summary_en: This paper proposes a training-free physics-constrained inverse solver for completing contiguous missing regions in coherent acoustic-field measurements. Its POCS-inspired relaxed projection–prox iterations alternate measurement consistency with a soft spectral wave-physics operator, and the method includes confidence weighting for noisy sensors plus an obstacle-aware scattered-field refinement. The work is directly relevant to computational acoustic imaging and incomplete-aperture sound-field reconstruction.
